title: Keynote - Preventing, Finding, and Fixing Bugs On a Time Budget | Raymond Hettinger @ PyBay2018
summary: Raymond Hettinger's PyBay 2018 keynote on preventing, finding and fixing bugs under a time budget. He covers testing practice, type annotation tradeoffs and the limits of coverage metrics.
why: HN cites it in Python testing and code quality threads, including his point that 100% coverage proves little.

quote.text: This is a good talk by the core developer Raymond Hettinger [1].
